# volcano_user_git_installations (Data Source)

GitHub App installations reachable through an account git connection, used as installation_id for volcano_project_git_connection.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "volcano_user_git_connections" "all" {}

data "volcano_user_git_installations" "example" {
  connection_id = data.volcano_user_git_connections.all.connections[0].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `connection_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `installations` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--installations))

<a id="nestedatt--installations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `installations`

- `account_type` (String)

- `repository_selection` (String)
